title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 37 (Red Rock Seed Orchard)
heading: Red Rock Seed Orchard
sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Red Rock Seed Orchard
37 That portion of the Province of British Columbia, in the vicinity of the City of Prince George, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All lands and waters within Lots 1607, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, Cariboo Land District. [en. B.C. Reg. 185/90, s. 9; am. B.C. Reg. 224/92, s. 8.]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
